Lena: Noticed a spike in project A's quota usage this morning but the traces show calls coming from a service account owned by org X. Billing team flagged it. Anyone seen weird SA impersonation behavior? :confused:
Mark: I saw a few requests where the `aud` claim changed mid-session during the impersonation flow. Suspect the token-minting service is dropping the `project_id` claim when it re-mints on behalf of the SA.
Priya: Do we have an example trace id? I can jump in and check request headers + auth logs.
Lena: Trace snippet (redacted):
```
trace: t-11cc
auth_chain: org-key -> sa-impersonation -> short-lived-token
initial_claims: {iss:auth.redwood, sub:sa-123, project_id:proj-A}
after_mint: {iss:mint, sub:sa-123, project_id: null}
```
Zoe: That would cause our quota router to fall back to org-level attribution, then later to projectless if any step misses the claim. We'll get double-counting in the UI if some tokens record proj-A and others are null.
Mark: Short-term mitigation: when the mint service issues a new token it should copy any `project_id` or `origin_project` claim from the incoming assertion into the minted token's `x-attrib` header so downstream routers have stable attribution.
Priya: Agreed. I'll add a small patch to mint-service to preserve `project_id` and also emit a `authz.attribution.source` metric with values `incoming_assertion` or `minted_default`.
Lena: For visibility, ops-bot can we annotate the billing dashboard for the window around 08:00-09:30 UTC? Finance is already asking.
ops-bot: Dashboard annotation created: "Impersonation-claim-issue suspected" (08:00-09:30 UTC) by deploy-ci :white_check_mark:
Zoe: UX note: add a column in the quota UI for "Attribution source" (org | project | projectless) and maybe a toggle to "Prefer incoming project claim" so SRE/finance can see corrected math without a migration.
Mark: Long-term: tighten the minting flow so it refuses to drop project claims unless explicitly requested by policy. Also add an audit event whenever claim is omitted during minting.
Priya: Deploy plan: canary the header-copy change to 5% of mint-service traffic, gate with `authz.attribution.preserve_canary=true` and monitor `metric.authz.attribution.missing_count`. I'll open the PR and include unit tests for claim copying.
Lena: Sounds good. Can we also run a retroactive re-attribution job to recompute quotas for the affected window once we confirm the fix? Finance prefers that rather than manual adjustments.
Zoe: I'll draft the re-attribution job (batch job that backfills using original assertions) and add it to the runbook. We'll include a small note in the UI explaining why historical numbers changed.
Priya: PR is up: https://staging.redwood/pull/4256 (includes tests + canary flag). Kicking off canary in ~15m.
Lena: Thanks team. Ping here when the canary is live and paste the metric dashboards. :thumbsup:
